properties.name: Ayodhya Service Area — Phase 1 Pilot
properties.description: 25 km radius service area centered on Ramkot temple complex (Ram Janmabhoomi site), Ayodhya, Uttar Pradesh, India.
properties.coordinate_source: Ramkot / Ram Janmabhoomi area, Ayodhya — coordinates 26.7958°N, 82.1947°E. Reference: Wikipedia 'Ayodhya' article (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ayodhya) and Google Maps landmark pin for Ram Janmabhoomi temple complex. Coordinates cross-verified against Uttar Pradesh government mapping records for Faizabad district (Ayodhya district).
properties.coverage_note: The 25 km radius is deliberately broad — Ayodhya city core is approximately 5 km across. This radius encompasses Ayodhya city, Faizabad city, and surrounding villages in Ambedkar Nagar / Barabanki / Gonda border areas. Phase 2 polygon refinement playbook: replace this with a tighter multi-polygon that follows actual panchayat / tehsil boundaries, or reduce radius to 15 km once field data confirms demand distribution. See ADR-0020.
properties.phase2_expansion: To add Lucknow or Varanasi in Phase 2: add additional Feature entries to the FeatureCollection in api/src/data/service-areas.geojson (not this single-city file). The service-area.service.ts isLatLngInServiceArea function accepts any GeoJSON Polygon Feature — load all polygons and run a union check.
